decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp builds on the firm's ergonomic task lighting expertise and has shown interpretable early results, so related knowledge supports keeping it.
General interior lighting is directly in the firm's core building lighting domain, giving it strong absorptive capacity to interpret and improve the product.
The microprismatic pendant luminaire is a flagship aligned with the firm's optical and energy-efficient direction, making it a high-priority keeper.
The marine HMI searchlight uses older non-LED technology and marine-specific knowledge outside the firm's LED-focused absorptive capacity.
The marine searchlight remains close enough to the firm's robust outdoor and industrial lighting expertise to be improved with existing R&D.
